context:
This item asks how often a PR must carry a Rules checked line. It does not block the PR.
Goal: a changed decision record is never left with a stale rule sentence, without a required line on edits that never needed one.
Problem (rule): PR 3492 makes a changed decision record need either each citing rule sentence changed or one line in the PR body, "Rules checked: <record> — no change". The lane measured that 90 of 135 main merges in the last 20 days that touched a record left CLAUDE.md unchanged. That is an upper bound by commit. A required line would fire on most record edits, so the cost lands on you and on every lane; whether to accept it is your call.
Based on (read): PR 3492 body and lane hand-in, relayed by the coordinator at 03:19 CST Nov 15; triage read no history.
Based on (measured): 90 of 135 record-touching main merges in 20 days left CLAUDE.md unchanged (lane's count, upper bound by commit; triage did not re-run it).
Departs from: main — adds a required PR-body line, or a rule-sentence change, on a PR that changes a decision record; today nothing is required.
Who recommends what: nobody has recommended an option; no star.
Meanwhile: PR 3492 is not held on this answer.

options.gain: Every record edit shows its rule sentences were checked, so no sentence stays stale unseen.
options.label: Keep the required Rules checked line as built
options.lose: A line to write on about two of three record edits, from lanes and from you.

options.gain: Fewer PRs need the line; the check fires only where a rule sentence plausibly moved.
options.how: The lane proposes a narrower trigger and a test, and the PR waits for that change.
options.label: Ask the lane to narrow when the line is required, then merge
options.lose: Some stale rule sentences could pass, and the lane must rebuild and re-test the trigger.
